name: Maihama Kyouko
source:
The mother of Sumito and Yuriko, doubles as the dynamic second president of Dream Garden.

Kyouko shares a vivid, outgoing personality with her son, Sumito. Yet, she stands out with her remarkable ability and vitality, effortlessly tackling even the most unwelcome tasks, making her, in some ways, a superior version of Sumito.

Her charismatic presence and exceptional skills allow her to control situations and live on her own terms. For fun, she enjoys working as a waitress at Dream Garden's "Snow Kingdom Cafe."
